claims.claim_text: Chrome 149 與 150 兩個版本合計修掉 1,072 個安全性 bug，比先前 23 個里程碑加起來還多
claims.evidence: In the last two milestones, Chrome 149 and 150, we have fixed 1072 security bugs, surpassing the total number of security bugs fixed across the prior 23 milestones combined.
claims.note: Exact match including the 23-milestone comparison. Timeliness: annual.

claims.claim_text: 2026 年初的 agent harness 掃到一個潛伏 13 年的 sandbox escape
claims.evidence: In early 2026, we built an agent harness that used Gemini to find vulnerabilities across the broader Chrome codebase ... a bug that quietly survived in our codebase for more than 13 years!
claims.note: Source says more than 13 years; post says 13 年 — slightly deflated, harmless.

claims.claim_text: spanification 已讓 97% 的第一方程式碼在嚴格 unsafe-buffer 警告下乾淨編譯
claims.evidence: Currently, 97% of first-party Chrome code compiles cleanly with strict unsafe-buffer warnings
claims.note: Post carries the source currently as 已, matching strength. Volatile figure, same-week source.

claims.claim_text: MiracleObject 的目標是壓制 GPU 主執行緒上多達九成的 UAF
claims.evidence: actively deploying MiracleObject with the aim of neutralizing up to 90% of UAF vulnerabilities on the GPU main thread
claims.note: Post preserves the aspirational framing and the up-to bound. No inflation.

claims.claim_text: 2024 年與 Project Zero 合作的 Naptime 給模型專用的研究工具，2025 年的 Big Sleep 在 V8 與繪圖元件裡挖洞
claims.evidence: we worked with Project Zero on Naptime, giving LLMs specialized tools for vulnerability research ... we collaborated with DeepMind and Project Zero on Big Sleep, an AI vulnerability discovery agent that successfully found bugs in the V8 JavaScript engine and graphics stack
claims.note: Years and scope confirmed. Post omits DeepMind as a Big Sleep collaborator — an omission, not a misstatement.

claims.claim_text: triage 自動化每月省下數百小時；發版節奏正轉向兩週一個里程碑、每週一次安全更新
claims.evidence: We estimate that this new process is saving hundreds of hours of developer time per month ... We are in the process of transitioning to a two-week cadence for major Chrome milestones, with weekly security updates
claims.note: 正轉向 matches in the process of transitioning; the vague magnitude is preserved.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic 回頭審了 141,006 次 cybersecurity evaluation run，找出三起模型在以為環境是模擬的情況下碰到真實基礎設施的事件
claims.evidence: After reviewing 141,006 evaluation runs where Claude could have obtained internet access, we identified three incidents
claims.note: 141,006 and three incidents both exact; the simulated-environment framing is supported by the prompt/misconfiguration passage.

claims.claim_text: 一個惡意 PyPI 套件被 15 台真實機器下載
claims.evidence: During that window, the package was downloaded and run on 15 real systems.
claims.note: Source says downloaded AND run; the post says only downloaded — deflated relative to source.

claims.claim_text: 三起分別牽涉 Claude Opus 4.7、Mythos 5 與一個內部研究模型
claims.evidence: The incidents involved three different Claude models: Opus 4.7, Mythos 5, and an internal research test model.
claims.note: Per-incident assignment also confirmed on re-fetch.

claims.claim_text: 只有最新的那個在認出系統是真的之後停手
claims.evidence: our latest model, an internal research test model, also considered whether its targets were in fact real. When evidence emerged that they were, it stopped the exercise.
claims.note: The exclusivity is supported by the article own account of incidents 1 and 2 continuing to exploit.

claims.claim_text: 它比 NLL 多出來的能力用原文的話說是 flow-sensitive borrow checking of lifetime outlives relationships
claims.evidence: flow-sensitive borrow checking of lifetime outlives relationships
claims.note: Quoted verbatim in the original English and correctly marked as 原文的話.

claims.claim_text: 效能量測跑過 crates.io 下載量前 10,000 名的 crate，顯著迴歸相對少見；前一萬名之外另外挑了借用特別多的 crate 測，最差看到 2 到 3 倍。
claims.evidence: From the top ten thousand crates by downloads on crates.io, we have seen relatively few significant regressions ... Outside the top ten thousand crates, we have focused mainly on crates with many borrows. The worst case we have seen is a 2-3x regression.
claims.note: Original lede fused two separate measurements so the 2-3x worst case read as the tail of the top-10k sample; the source places it OUTSIDE the top ten thousand, on a separate borrow-heavy sample. FIXED: the lede now separates the two measurements and names the download-ranked corpus explicitly.

claims.claim_text: 不想吃這一版的可以用 -Zpolonius=off 退回 NLL，穩定化目標是年底前
claims.evidence: -Zpolonius=off ... stabilize prior to the end of the year
claims.note: Flag spelling exact; 目標是 matches aim to.

claims.claim_text: NLL 把一個 borrow 當成在整個函式都活著，Polonius Alpha 知道不同控制流路徑上的借用需求不一樣，所以 get_mut_or_default 模式終於編得過
claims.evidence: now compiles because Polonius Alpha recognizes that a borrow from map.get_mut(&key) in the Some branch need not persist through the None branch — something NLL cannot determine.
claims.note: Causal link is the source own explanation; get_mut_or_default is the source worked example.

claims.claim_text: 仍有原始 Polonius 接受而 Alpha 拒絕的程式，反過來也有，官方定調是兩種取捨而非嚴格的高低
claims.evidence: (As a slight note: we have also found programs that compile with Polonius Alpha but not legacy Polonius, so it is not really a full subset.)
claims.note: Bidirectional non-containment confirmed; the source is the official Rust blog.

claims.claim_text: MCP 規格從 2025-11-25 走到 2026-07-28，核心改動是把協定變成無狀態——initialize/initialized handshake 與 Mcp-Session-Id header 整組消失
claims.evidence: the transition from MCP specification version 2025-11-25 to 2026-07-28 ... The new spec eliminates: the initialize/initialized handshake (SEP-2575), the Mcp-Session-Id header (SEP-2567)
claims.note: Both spec dates and both removals confirmed.

claims.claim_text: SEP-2243 的路由 header 讓負載平衡不必拆封包、SEP-2549 的 ttlMs 與 cacheScope 取代長連線 SSE、SEP-2322 用 InputRequiredResult 加序列化的 requestState 把多輪往返做成任何一個執行個體都能接手
claims.evidence: HTTP Standardization (SEP-2243): Three routing headers enable gateway-level traffic management without inspecting request bodies: Mcp-Protocol-Version, Mcp-Method, Mcp-Name ... Caching Enhancement (SEP-2549): Responses now include ttlMs and cacheScope fields ... Multi-Round-Trip Requests (SEP-2322): Servers return InputRequiredResult with serialized requestState, allowing any load-balanced instance to handle continuation requests.
claims.note: All three SEP numbers, all field/header names, and the stated purpose of each map onto the source without drift.

claims.claim_text: 代價寫在 SEP-2577 裡：roots、sampling、logging 三者進入至少 12 個月的棄用窗
claims.evidence: Formal Deprecation Policy (SEP-2577): Features entering deprecation include roots, sampling, and logging, with a minimum 12-month transition window.
claims.note: SEP number, the three deprecated features, and 至少 12 個月 all match.

claims.claim_text: GitHub 的 MCP Server 已經把 Redis session storage 整個拿掉
claims.evidence: The GitHub MCP Server has already completely removed Redis session storage following this specification.
claims.note: 已經 matches has already; 整個拿掉 matches completely removed.

claims.claim_text: Boris Kolpackov 拿 Xerces-C++ 的 299 個 translation unit 當題目來量：Ninja 跑 3.4 秒，但前面還要 15.6 秒讓 CMake 產生 build 檔；build2 預設 3.8 秒
claims.evidence: 299 C++ files compiled into a shared library ... Ninja: 3.4 seconds (3.429s +/- 0.029s mean) ... CMake generation: 15.6 seconds ... build2 (default): 3.8 seconds (3.808s +/- 0.046s mean)
claims.note: Author name, TU count, and all three timings confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 關掉會 tokenize 原始碼再算 checksum 的精確變更追蹤後掉到 3.4 秒，再關掉 file cache 壓縮是 3.355 秒
claims.evidence: it tokenizes the (partially-preprocessed) source file and computes the checksum of the resulting tokens ... With this change our build time goes down to 3.4s, pretty much the same as Ninja s ... Next, we disable compression in the file cache ... 3.355s +/- 0.067s
claims.note: Verified the mechanism description too, not just the numbers; the ladder ordering matches.

claims.claim_text: 把探測到的資訊快取起來（他引另一篇文章的案例對照：CMake 把 Xcode 路徑與 OS 版本重複探測了 85 次）
claims.evidence: It also studiously re-checks the Xcode path and OS version 85 times, just in case the OS version changes mid-build. ... in build2 we aggressively cache every piece of discovered information
claims.note: Original lede said CMake 在同一個例子裡叫了編譯器 85 次 — two errors: the 85 figure is quoted by build2 from a DIFFERENT article about a different project, and it counts repeated Xcode-path/OS-version probes, not compiler invocations. FIXED: the lede now attributes the figure to the cited third-party article and describes it as repeated environment probing.

claims.claim_text: A customer had cancelled months earlier and our database still said active; some customer.subscription.deleted had evaporated between Stripe and us, and nothing anywhere was capable of noticing.
claims.evidence: A customer had cancelled months earlier and our database still said `active`; some `customer.subscription.deleted` had evaporated between Stripe and us, and nothing anywhere was capable of noticing: not their dashboard, which showed the delivery as retried and eventually dropped, and not our logs, which cannot log a request that never arrived.
claims.note: Word-for-word identical through noticing. The truncation removes no qualification and changes no meaning.

claims.claim_text: SCROLL 由提供方開一個以 cursor 定址的有序變更日誌讓消費端自己拉，去重表沒了、排序緩衝沒了、bootstrap 競態沒了、刪除變成可驗證的 tombstone 事件
claims.evidence: SCROLL (Synchronized Change Replication Over Line Logs) proposes a consumer-pull model where: Providers expose cursor-addressed, ordered change logs; Consumers issue GET requests (no cursor = bootstrap from beginning); Events carry full current object state for idempotent upserts; Tombstone events represent deletes explicitly; Optional checksum verification confirms replica correctness
claims.note: Every element of the enumeration maps to a bullet in the source; the compensating-mechanism list also matches the source five layers exactly.

claims.claim_text: 累積帶來 Instagram 6%、Facebook 3% 的轉換提升與 Facebook 3.5% 的廣告點擊
claims.evidence: These sequence-derived representations drove a cumulative lift of 6% in conversions on Instagram, 3% on Facebook and 3.5% in ad clicks on Facebook.
claims.note: All three figures, both platforms, and the conversion-vs-click split match exactly; the lede prefixes 他們宣稱, appropriate visible attribution for a single-source vendor benchmark.

claims.claim_text: 他們宣稱這條路呈現 LLM 式的可預測擴張，效能隨 FLOPs 呈 log-linear 改善
claims.evidence: Performance improvements follow a log-linear relationship with respect to compute, with a marked improvement in scaling efficiency over other transformer-based sequence models.
claims.note: log-linear confirmed; FLOPs is the standard unit of compute here. 他們宣稱 adds attribution the source states flatly — deflated.

claims.claim_text: 中間的接法是 dense tokenization——把稀疏特徵與序列行為併進同一套詞彙表，讓 attention 自己從資料裡找出特徵之間怎麼互動
claims.evidence: This tokenization approach integrates sparse features with sequential behavioral data into a single dense vocabulary, enabling attention mechanisms to discover interactions independently.
claims.note: The surrounding two-stage split the lede describes is also confirmed, including sequence lengths in the thousands and cached user-level embeddings.

claims.claim_text: 2026 年 7 月跑了 524 萬次編譯，月成本約 3,600 美金，平均一次 0.0007 美金
claims.evidence: 5,238,210 compilations in July, and 78.7 million over the last twelve months ... costs us somewhere around $3,600 a month on AWS at the moment, which works out at about $0.0007 per compilation.
claims.note: 5,238,210 rounds correctly to 524 萬; 約 and 平均 preserve the source hedges.

claims.claim_text: Everything that needs to survive lives on the shared filesystem, in S3 or in DynamoDB, so an instance that vanishes is just an instance that gets replaced
claims.evidence: Everything that needs to survive lives on the shared filesystem, in S3 or in DynamoDB, so an instance that vanishes is just an instance that gets replaced.
claims.note: Verbatim. The adjacent spot-instance claim is also confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 93 種語言、6,157 個編譯器放在 EFS 上會拖慢一切
claims.evidence: 6,157 entries across 93 languages
claims.note: Both figures exact; the EFS-slowness rationale and the intermediate SquashFS step are the source own.

claims.claim_text: 再演進到內容定址的 CEFS，把東西收成 121 個約 20GB 的 bundle 用 autofs 按需掛載，開機從 50 秒降到 20 秒，儲存從 3.9TB 降到 2.2TB
claims.evidence: content-addressed images, packed into bundles of around 20GB, mounted on demand ... The migration took us from 2,182 images down to 121, and OS startup from 50 seconds to 20! ... 2.2T, where a year ago it was 3.9T
claims.note: All four numbers confirmed. Completeness caveat for the human reviewer: the source adds that the image count has crept back up to around 883 since; 121 is accurate as the migration result but is not the current count.

claims.claim_text: 每個 object 就是一個以名稱定址的 SQLite 資料庫，複製到你自己的 S3 相容 bucket，而 Nodes coordinate through that bucket alone, with no control plane or consensus
claims.evidence: Each object is its own SQLite database, addressed by name and replicated to an S3-compatible bucket you own; nodes coordinate through that bucket alone, with no control plane or consensus.
claims.note: Verbatim except a capitalised leading N (lowercase mid-sentence in the source). Cosmetic.

claims.claim_text: 同一時間只有一個節點擁有某個 cell，靠物件儲存的 compare-and-swap 保證，因此不需要成員協定，也不需要故障偵測器
claims.evidence: Object-storage compare-and-swap ensures that exactly one node owns a cell at a time, without a membership protocol, failure detector, or consensus service.
claims.note: Exclusive ownership, the CAS mechanism, and both negative consequences are all in one source sentence.

claims.claim_text: 每個節點內嵌 V8 執行 Wrangler bundle，cell 遷移或重新啟動時，新的擁有者把資料庫還原後繼續跑
claims.evidence: Every celld node embeds V8 and executes Wrangler bundles. ... When a cell moves or wakes up, its new owner restores that database and resumes execution.
claims.note: Both halves verbatim-backed.

claims.claim_text: AOT 編譯把冷啟動從數百毫秒壓到次毫秒
claims.evidence: Evaluations demonstrate that Ahead-of-Time (AOT) compilation reduces cold-start latencies from hundreds of milliseconds to sub-millisecond ranges
claims.note: Verbatim from the abstract.

claims.claim_text: credit-based sliding window 把短執行路徑的通訊成本攤掉，單一 worker 的吞吐量最多提升 4.3 倍
claims.evidence: To optimize short execution paths, it utilizes a credit-based sliding window to amortize inter-process communication costs. ... the credit window improves single-worker throughput by up to 4.3x
claims.note: The 4.3x really is scoped to single-worker throughput, and the short-execution-path framing is the source stated motivation. 最多 carries up to.

claims.claim_text: 把 pipeline 的每一段做成長時間存活的 WebAssembly component，依 queue-depth 的 SLO 各自縮放，段與段之間走沒有 broker 的 ZeroMQ 通道；作者的定位是繞開 Apache OpenWhisk 那類編排器瓶頸與容器額外成本
claims.evidence: Epico executes pipeline stages as persistent WebAssembly components, enabling independent, zero-to-infinity autoscaling based on queue-depth SLOs and routing events directly between stages using broker-free ZeroMQ channels. ... Compared to Apache OpenWhisk, Epico bypasses the orchestrator bottlenecks and container overheads that typically hinder FaaS streaming workloads.
claims.note: Every architectural element matches the abstract; 作者的定位是 correctly attributes the OpenWhisk comparison.
